headers.reverse_row_trace:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i : ℕ) (rs : Weights)
    (out : SampleRecords.Records) (r acc : List SampleRecords.Entry) :
    Trace (transition es) (r.length+1) (.revRow i rs out r acc)
      (.row (i+1) rs ((r.reverse++acc)::out))
headers.reverse_matrix_trace:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (R acc : SampleRecords.Records) :
    Trace (transition es) (R.length+1) (.revMatrix R acc) (.halt (R.reverse++acc))
headers.rows_trace:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i : ℕ) (W : Weights)
    (out : SampleRecords.Records) :
    Trace (transition es) (rowsSteps es i W) (.row i W out)
      (.row (i+W.length) [] ((values es i W).reverse++out))
headers.materialize_trace:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (W : Weights) :
    Trace (transition es) (matrixSteps es W) (.row 0 W []) (.halt (values es 0 W))
headers.rowSteps_le:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i j : ℕ) (r : List ℚ) :
    rowSteps es i j r ≤ r.length*(listSize es+10)+1
headers.rowsSteps_le:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (i : ℕ) (W : Weights) :
    rowsSteps es i W ≤ cellCount W*(listSize es+11)+3*W.length
headers.matrixSteps_le:
(es : StoredSample.EdgeLists) (W : Weights) :
    matrixSteps es W ≤ cellCount W*(listSize es+11)+4*W.length+2
